headline: Burco Products Acquires Delta Kits
summary: Burco Products has acquired Delta Kits, creating a unified entity for automotive aftermarket glass repair and replacement. Bamidele Ali has been appointed as the new Chief Executive Officer of the combined firm.
why: M&A activity in the automotive aftermarket sector reflects consolidation trends aimed at increasing market share and operational efficiency.

impacts.name: Burco Products
impacts.why: Acquirer is expanding its business footprint.
